name_reason: Global is a single 4-byte heap pointer (declared uint8 *) to the currently loaded DATO.DAT portrait sprite blob. Naming convention asks the global name to reflect its datatype (table/array/flag/pointer/counter); sibling pointer globals in the same domain/file use the _ptr / _buf_ptr suffix (data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr, data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf_ptr, data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr, data_fd2_dialog_current_speaker_char_ptr). Current name omits the pointer marker. Proposed data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buf_ptr keeps the correct domain (portrait/dialog) and adds the pointer/datatype marker for consistency. No Ghidra address residue in either name. Recorded only; rename applied in Stage 2 (touches globals.h + all 6 writer/reader sites).
purpose: Single heap pointer to the currently loaded portrait sprite blob (a DATO.DAT resource) used to blit character/speaker faces into dialog and status-screen panels.
logic_summary: Holds the base pointer returned by fd2_load_dat_resource("DATO.DAT" @ 0x51A70, prev_buf, portrait_id). The reload pattern passes the previous pointer value back to the loader as the reusable buffer, then stores the freshly returned pointer. Consumers dereference it as a byte buffer whose head is a per-portrait-frame int offset table: sprite_pixels = buf + *(int*)(buf + frame*4); the frame-0 / dialog-open path uses buf + *buf where the low byte is the header-size offset (skip past header). Written/reloaded on every speaker/portrait setup; never freed standalone (the same allocation is reused). Pure runtime state, relies on zero-init at startup, no static initializer.
element_semantics: Scalar pointer (not an array). Points at the loaded DATO.DAT portrait resource blob; the pointed-to blob begins with a table of int frame-offsets (frame 0 offset's low byte = header size), followed by 2bpp sprite pixel data for each mouth-open/close frame.
notes: BSS global at .object2 0x53A85, all-zero at rest (zero-init). 25 xrefs across 6 functions (fd2_display_dialog_scene, fd2_paint_portrait_to_dialog_area [read-only], fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout, fd2_load_chapter_portrait, fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop [read-only], fd2_run_equip_member_menu, fd2_run_status_screen_member_menu, fd2_play_final_chapter_30_ending) with both READ and WRITE -> mutable, non-const. dialog.c comment block (lines 1322-1346) already accurate/precise (matches Ghidra writers exactly, header-skip deref, zero-init), so comment kept and dialog.c not edited. Ghidra data plate was empty (PLATE=null) -> created a concise plate consistent with the src conclusion. Only the shard file is committed (no src change).
